cartago: BEGIN READ ONLY; WITH o AS (SELECT id,'edificios' capa,to_jsonb(t)::text payload FROM local_cartago.edificios t UNION ALL SELECT id,'carreteras' capa,to_jsonb(t)::text payload FROM local_cartago.carreteras t UNION ALL SELECT id,'aceras' capa,to_jsonb(t)::text payload FROM local_cartago.aceras t UNION ALL SELECT id,'parqueos' capa,to_jsonb(t)::text payload FROM local_cartago.parqueos t UNION ALL SELECT id,'zonas_verdes' capa,to_jsonb(t)::text payload FROM local_cartago.zonas_verdes t UNION ALL SELECT id,'puntos_interes' capa,to_jsonb(t)::text payload FROM local_cartago.puntos_interes t UNION ALL SELECT id,'iluminacion' capa,to_jsonb(t)::text payload FROM local_cartago.iluminacion t UNION ALL SELECT id,'accesibilidad' capa,to_jsonb(t)::text payload FROM local_cartago.accesibilidad t) SELECT count(*),count(DISTINCT id),count(*) FILTER(WHERE g.id IS NULL OR g.capa<>o.capa),count(*) FILTER(WHERE id / 1000000000 <> 1) FROM o LEFT JOIN ops.identificadores_globales g USING(id); SELECT rolname FROM pg_roles WHERE pg_has_role(oid,'sigtec_mantenimiento_id','MEMBER'); COMMIT;
